top_signals.title: Sharks Fitted with Sensors to Help Hurricane Predictions
top_signals.summary: From the killer shark of "Jaws" to the tornado-tossed predators of the "Sharknado" movies, films long have portrayed sharks as objects of summer fear. But when a shark cuts through the waters off the U.S. East Coast, it now may be doing more than hunting.
